description: [Truck fuel: EIA diesel surcharge] U.S. EIA weekly on-highway diesel for the U.S. or a PADD (default Rocky Mountain, PADD 4): price per gallon, week-over-week change, and per-mile surcharge max(0, current - base) / mpg, plus the EIA release date. Public weekly page, no API key. Cached until the next Monday/Tuesday release. Source: U.S. EIA. ?padd=4&base=5.5&mpg=6. $0.005 USDC. Paid: $0.005 USDC on Base, paid in-band via x402 MCP (@x402/mcp; _meta "x402/payment"). Also at GET https://micro-saas-agent.onrender.com/api/truck/fuel-surcharge.
